facilities.source: https://georgiawildlife.com/charlie-elliott-wildlife-center ('20 campsites, all containing electricity, water, wireless wifi, picnic table, and fire ring'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: $40 a night at every full-facility RV site, weekday or Saturday; the six tent-only sites are $20. Read on Go Outdoors Georgia for 2026-11-10, 2027-06-16 and 2027-06-19.

fees.source: Go Outdoors Georgia facID=1 GetReservationCost for Sites 1-14 (Price 40.00) and Tent 1-6 (20.00), arrival 6/16/2027, Site 3 also 6/19/2027 and 11/10/2026, read 2026-10-29

values.note: Go Outdoors Georgia (Wildlife Resources Division's own reservation site) or 1-800-366-2661. 'Reservations can be made up to 13 months in advance.' 'Camping is limited to 14 consecutive days at any one facility.
